name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2026-05-12, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
